description:
Former NBA stars Andre Iguodala and Evan Turner, who forged their bond on the court, have reunited to bring you the Point Forward Podcast. Named after their distinctive position in the league, these two unfiltered voices are ready to share the bold opinions and insights that endeared them to fans and stirred controversy during their careers.

Join Dre and Evan each week as they delve into the latest in sports, business, and culture. Enjoy engaging conversations with a rotating lineup of elite athletes, musicians, and entrepreneurs. Always candid, unconventional, and witty—welcome to the future
